Technical SEO.title: Google Search On URLs: Ranking Factor, Hyphens vs Underscores & Emojis
Technical SEO.summary: Google launched a new Search Central video series called The Non-Canonical Cabinet, with the first episode featuring Gary Illyes discussing how Google handles URLs as a ranking signal, including the hyphens-versus-underscores debate and emoji use in URLs. This is a direct, Google-sourced clarification on URL best practices relevant to enterprise site architecture decisions.

Technical SEO.title: Google Launches A Video Series For Odd Technical SEO Questions
Technical SEO.summary: Google's new Search Central video series addresses unusual technical SEO questions, with the first episode covering emoji, non-English characters, and keywords in URLs. The SEJ writeup provides additional editorial context on the same Non-Canonical Cabinet launch covered in the Roundtable item above.

Technical SEO.title: Analysis: Google Is Poisoning Search Results For Rank Trackers
Technical SEO.summary: An analysis argues that Google is reportedly manipulating the search results served to rank-tracking tools, which undermines the reliability of SEO data that businesses use to make strategic decisions. This has significant implications for enterprise teams relying on rank-tracker data to measure performance.

Technical SEO.title: Google Explains How They Rank PDFs And What It Means For SEO/GEO
Technical SEO.summary: Google has clarified how it ranks PDFs in both traditional Search and AI Mode, and the article explains how to audit whether a PDF is SEO-friendly. This is directly actionable for enterprise sites with large PDF libraries, such as cruise itineraries or automotive spec sheets.

Technical SEO.title: Google Tests AI Mode Left Sidebar On Main Google Search Results Page
Technical SEO.summary: Google is testing a left vertical sidebar on the main web search results page that mirrors the AI Mode interface, including a chat history panel, AI Mode entry point, and settings icon. This SERP layout change could affect organic visibility and click-through patterns at enterprise scale.

Technical SEO.title: Clicks, Impressions and Positions from AI Mode in Google Search Console
Technical SEO.summary: This piece covers how to track clicks, impressions, and position data specifically from Google AI Mode within Google Search Console. Understanding AI Mode performance data in GSC is a foundational measurement capability for enterprise SEO teams adapting to AI-driven SERPs.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Your AI Visibility Score May Be Hiding a Problem
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The article warns that brand mentions and source citations in AI platforms often tell very different stories, and marketers need to identify which metric is underperforming before choosing a strategy. This is a critical framing issue for enterprise teams building GEO measurement frameworks.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Why SEO Isn't Enough Anymore - And Why That's A Good Thing
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece argues that brands relying solely on search as their primary channel face growing exposure, pointing to Google's Helpful Content Update as a catalyst for purging SEO-first sites. It frames the shift toward diversified presence as a strategic opportunity rather than a threat.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Your Store Is Agent-Ready By Default, We Tested 122 Shopify Stores To See What That Actually Means
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A study of 122 Shopify stores found that a store can appear agent-ready by default yet still fail when an AI shopping agent queries it for details like shipping, pickup, or cancellation policies. The findings are applicable to any enterprise commerce or travel booking property targeting AI agent discovery.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: OpenAI Drops UTM Parameters From ChatGPT Results
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: OpenAI appears to have removed the UTM parameters it previously appended to outbound links in ChatGPT results, making it harder for analytics teams to attribute traffic back to ChatGPT as a referral source. The change is reported to have coincided with the release of GPT-6.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Tracking AI Overviews: What the Data Actually Shows
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The HubSpot piece examines what data is actually available when tracking AI Overviews performance, a measurement gap that enterprise SEO teams are actively trying to close. The title signals a data-driven approach rather than generic guidance.

AI Search / GEO.title: LLM Citation Study: 13,184 Citations Across 4 AI Tools
AI Search / GEO.summary: Orbit Media analyzed citation patterns across 13,184 instances from four AI tools to identify which types of sources are most frequently referenced in AI-generated answers. This dataset is directly actionable for enterprise GEO strategy, including identifying content formats and authority signals that earn AI citations.

AI Search / GEO.title: Five Possible Backdoors into LLM Search Results
AI Search / GEO.summary: The article identifies five potential approaches to influencing what content surfaces in LLM-powered search results, framed as an investigative look at the mechanics of AI answer generation. Understanding these pathways is directly relevant to enterprise GEO strategy and AI search visibility work.

AI Search / GEO.title: Mastering Generative Engine Optimization in 2026: Full Guide
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land published a comprehensive guide to GEO in 2026, covering the tactics and frameworks needed to optimize content for AI-powered answer engines. As a trusted trade publication, this is a higher-credibility reference than the many vendor-produced GEO guides in the raw pool.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini & Google AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: LLM Pulse compiled a cross-platform data study identifying which domains receive the most citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI surfaces. Benchmarking domain authority against top-cited competitors is a foundational step in any enterprise AI visibility audit.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Ends Spam Update, Opens UGC: DesignRush SEO Roundup
AI Search / GEO.summary: The DesignRush roundup covers the completion of a Google spam update alongside changes to UGC handling and AI Overviews developments, providing a consolidated view of recent Google algorithm activity. Algorithm update completion is high-priority signal for enterprise SEO teams monitoring ranking stability.

AI Search / GEO.title: Study: LinkedIn Profiles Are Barely Visible to Search and AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: Research from Humandex found that LinkedIn profiles have very low visibility in both traditional search and AI-generated answers, which has implications for personal brand and entity authority strategies that feed into GEO. For enterprise teams building author and expert entity signals, this is a notable data point.
